concepts.label: Home
concepts.meaning: Home or top-level destination. Do not substitute for Back.

concepts.label: Menu
concepts.meaning: Open navigation or a menu.

concepts.label: More
concepts.meaning: Additional actions in an overflow menu.

concepts.label: Search
concepts.meaning: Find content. A heavier lens still has an open center.

concepts.label: Grid
concepts.meaning: Open an application grid or change to grid view.

concepts.label: Arrow left
concepts.meaning: Literal left arrow; application chooses its navigation role.

concepts.label: Arrow right
concepts.meaning: A literal right arrow. Navigation direction must be chosen by the application.

concepts.label: Arrow up
concepts.meaning: Literal up arrow, not Upload.

concepts.label: Arrow down
concepts.meaning: Literal down arrow, not Download.

concepts.label: Arrow up right
concepts.meaning: Open another destination. Keep a visible action label.

concepts.label: Chevron left
concepts.meaning: Compact left direction. Navigation semantics stay in the component.

concepts.label: Chevron right
concepts.meaning: Compact right direction. Not an external-link marker.

concepts.label: Chevron up
concepts.meaning: Up direction or collapse, with a label.

concepts.label: Chevron down
concepts.meaning: Down direction or disclosure, with a label.

concepts.label: Plus
concepts.meaning: Add or create. Distinct from expand and zoom-in.

concepts.label: Minus
concepts.meaning: Decrease or subtract. Not a destructive delete substitute.

concepts.label: Check
concepts.meaning: Confirm or communicate completion.

concepts.label: Close
concepts.meaning: Dismiss or close. Do not use as a destructive delete substitute.

concepts.label: Edit
concepts.meaning: A pencil for editing content.

concepts.label: Copy
concepts.meaning: Create a duplicate or copy to clipboard.

concepts.label: Trash
concepts.meaning: Delete. Confirm destructive behavior at the application level.

concepts.label: Refresh
concepts.meaning: Reload the current data. Not Undo or Redo.

concepts.label: Filter
concepts.meaning: A funnel that narrows a result set. Not generic adjustment controls.

concepts.label: Sliders
concepts.meaning: Adjust parameters. Not a funnel filter or gear glyph.

concepts.label: Upload
concepts.meaning: Transfer into a service.

concepts.label: Download
concepts.meaning: Transfer out to this device.

concepts.label: Save
concepts.meaning: A disk metaphor for committing changes. Not Bookmark or Download.

concepts.label: File
concepts.meaning: A document. Not a duplicate action.

concepts.label: Folder
concepts.meaning: A folder or grouped files.

concepts.label: Link
concepts.meaning: A link or related resource. Not external navigation by itself.

concepts.label: Bookmark
concepts.meaning: Save a reference for later. Different from saving changed data.

concepts.label: Star
concepts.meaning: Favorite or rating, with context. Distinct from Focus.

concepts.label: Calendar
concepts.meaning: A date or calendar.

concepts.label: User
concepts.meaning: A person or profile.

concepts.label: Chat
concepts.meaning: A message or conversation.

concepts.label: Bell
concepts.meaning: Notifications. Do not imply a warning or failure by shape alone.

concepts.label: Warning
concepts.meaning: A warning requiring a visible text label in every supported appearance and native size.

concepts.label: Info
concepts.meaning: Information about content or a status. Distinct from Help and Warning.

concepts.label: Help
concepts.meaning: Assistance or documentation. Distinct from information status.

concepts.label: Lock
concepts.meaning: Restricted access or locked content.

concepts.label: Shield
concepts.meaning: Protection or policy. Pair with the actual status in text.

concepts.label: Gear
concepts.meaning: A gear settings metaphor. Sliders remains a separate adjustment glyph.

concepts.label: Terminal
concepts.meaning: A command interface. Not an ordinary next arrow.

concepts.label: Branch
concepts.meaning: A branching relationship. Use a visible label, especially at 12 px.

concepts.label: Chart
concepts.meaning: A bar chart or analytics view.

concepts.label: Play
concepts.meaning: Play media or start an operation. Do not auto-mirror in RTL.

concepts.label: Pause
concepts.meaning: Pause an operation. Do not use for stop.

concepts.label: Focus
concepts.meaning: Focus a region. Context is required; not a star or fullscreen symbol.

concepts.label: Activity
concepts.meaning: A pulse of activity; existing registry activity motif.

concepts.label: Align center
concepts.meaning: Align selected objects on a horizontal center axis; distinct from text paragraph formatting.

concepts.label: Align left
concepts.meaning: Align selected objects to their left edge; distinct from paragraph formatting.

concepts.label: Align right
concepts.meaning: Align selected objects to their right edge; distinct from paragraph formatting.

concepts.label: Box
concepts.meaning: A package or inventory box.

concepts.label: Check circle
concepts.meaning: Confirmed or successful status in an enclosing circle.

concepts.label: Circle
concepts.meaning: A circular shape; do not imply control behavior.

concepts.label: Ban
concepts.meaning: Prohibited or unavailable action.

concepts.label: Close circle
concepts.meaning: Dismissed or failed status in an enclosing circle.

concepts.label: Cursor
concepts.meaning: A pointer or selection tool.

concepts.label: Dot
concepts.meaning: A small solid dot, optically distinct from the full-size Circle.

concepts.label: Chevrons left
concepts.meaning: Jump left or to the first item, with an enclosing action label.

concepts.label: Chevrons right
concepts.meaning: Jump right or to the last item, with an enclosing action label.

concepts.label: Bold
concepts.meaning: Bold text formatting; authored letter B, no font outline reuse.

concepts.label: Type
concepts.meaning: Typography or text-size controls; authored letter T.

concepts.label: Group
concepts.meaning: Group or arrange selected objects, matching the current selection-group meaning.

concepts.label: Heart
concepts.meaning: Like or favorite with context; distinct from Star.

concepts.label: Input
concepts.meaning: A text input field with an insertion cursor.

concepts.label: Laptop
concepts.meaning: A laptop device or desktop-sized preview.

concepts.label: Wand
concepts.meaning: An assisted or automatic action, with an action label.

concepts.label: Smartphone
concepts.meaning: A mobile phone device or narrow preview.

concepts.label: Moon
concepts.meaning: Dark appearance or night; not a generic status.

concepts.label: Square
concepts.meaning: A square shape; do not imply control behavior.

concepts.label: Layers
concepts.meaning: A stack of layers or related objects.

concepts.label: Sun
concepts.meaning: Light appearance or daylight.

concepts.label: Table
concepts.meaning: Tabular data with a header and cells.

concepts.label: Loader
concepts.meaning: An in-progress segmented ring; animation belongs to the caller.

concepts.label: Code
concepts.meaning: Source code brackets, distinct from the Terminal prompt.

concepts.label: Dashboard
concepts.meaning: An overview of multiple panels, distinct from a uniform Grid.
